title: Spatiotemporal modulation of surface texture for information encoding and object manipulation
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 22 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74794-3

Dynamic control of surface textures is limited by static or coarse-patterned approaches, restricting their application in programmable object manipulation and information encoding. This study achieved reversible, spatiotemporally programmable surface wrinkling on a photothermal liquid crystal elastomer bilayer, enabling precise, on-demand surface patterning, object propulsion, self-erasing information encoding, and reversible assembly processes through localized light stimuli.

title: Deterministic, dynamically reconfigurable single quantum emitters enabled by tip-enhanced nano-optical trapping spectroscopy
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 22 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74532-9

A tip-enhanced nano-optical trapping spectroscopy enables deterministic trapping and dynamic control of single quantum emitters, including reversible switching between weak and strong light-matter coupling regimes.

title: AOC1 regulates labor initiation through spermidine-induced autophagy of placental trophoblast cells via EIF5A hypusination
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 22 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74698-2

A study in mice and humans reveals that a placental enzyme AOC1 and the molecule spermidine help time labor through regulating autophagy. Boosting spermidine prevented preterm birth, suggesting a potential therapy for human premature labor.

title: Structural basis for distinct protective mechanisms of IGHV3-23 antibodies targeting influenza hemagglutinin stem
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 22 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74658-w

Antibodies that target the stem region of the influenza haemagglutinin are sought because this region is conserved between different clades and subtypes of the virus. Here, the authors characterize three stem reactive human antibodies and show functional neutralization and binding specificity, showing differences in binding site as well as Fc-dependent effector function.

title: Anion-exchange fluorinated ion conductors for stable high-voltage lithium battery
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 22 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74773-8

Conventional fluorination cannot resolve the stability/ion-transport trade-off in solid electrolytes. Here, authors report core-shell Li-fluoride/LiCl nanocomposite precursors to synthesize heavily fluorinated Li-halide and Li-sulfide electrolytes with both high ionic conductivity and good oxidative stability.

title: A natural variation in rice susceptibility factor Rsf1 confers resistance to root-knot nematode
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 22 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74677-7

Rice root-knot nematode (RRKN) is one of the most destructive pathogenic nematodes threatening rice production worldwide. Here, the authors report the identification of RRKN susceptibility factor 1 (Rsf1) and show its usefulness in enhancing RRKN resistance without impacting yield in field conditions.

title: Enzyme-inspired single-molecule photocatalyst enables singlet-oxygen-driven asymmetric epoxidation and sulfoximination
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 22 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74592-x

The development of catalytic systems for the enantioselective epoxidation of sterically hindered trisubstituted alkenes and the oxidation of sulfilimines to sulfoximines using molecular oxygen (O₂) as the terminal oxidant remains a formidable challenge. Here, the authors report a biomimetic bifunctional photocatalyst that integrates a chiral manganese center and a covalently tethered anthraquinone photosensitizer within a single molecular scaffold.

title: Collaborative passive cooling of impact-hardening interfaces enabled by nacre-mimetic design
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 22 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74755-w

This study presents a nacre-inspired material that passively cools outdoor devices while absorbing impacts, offering recyclable, low-carbon protection for electronics and equipment in harsh environments.
